_source: MMIQ v3.1 validated cohort — 2,674 patients, 38,325 meals, 5.12M CGM readings (mmiq project/research/findings_data.json) + REST_HEPATIC_DAWN_FINDINGS.md
circadian_cite: q2 time-of-day: same meal spikes +12.35 mg/dL at breakfast vs dinner (n=38,325, p=5e-4)

protein_first.say: start with the vegetables/dal, carbs last

fiber.say: add a fibre source (dal, salad, sabzi)

restraint_cite: q5 within-patient same-meal variance (n=1,161) — single-meal response is noisy; suggest only on a confident, repeated signal
dawn_guardrail: dawn is a MINORITY phenotype (26% of non-hypo nights; cohort net -15 mg/dL) — a hypothesis, never assumed. Somogyi rebound +19.4 mg/dL in 85.8% of 704 patients is the robust one. Never claim CGM-derived cortisol.
_thresholds_placeholder: slot carb targets, the balanced-plate rule, and the MEAL/PHYSIOLOGY residual cut-offs are heuristic and MUST be pinned to ADA / diabetes-India MNT values before patient-facing use (see 02_WHAT_GOES_INTO_REBUILD.md §8).
